about: Indices of the 1024-kanji set (v1.2) reserved in the first namespace. A mark that matches the rule (any shown kanji in wildcard, or its first in A and its second in B) means: choose another. It names no one and attests nothing.
Not a roster. Nothing here can be verified against. Whoever wears a match anyway gets look-alike from the verifier, never a false yes.
It only grows. An index never leaves this file; a retired name is still a taken name.
